o11-lamp-on.observed_description: At night Ana sits on a grey sofa and holds the pole switch of a tall floor lamp whose glowing shade lights the room warmly; the window is dark.
o11-lamp-on.note: Usable: the lamp is clearly on, also in the 4:5 crop; a faint dark frame on the far wall is not a TV that could be read as on.

o13-tv-on.observed_description: In the evening Luis in a navy T-shirt sits in a dark-blue armchair and points one remote at a TV showing mountains and a lake; his other hand rests on his knee; a lit tripod floor lamp stands behind.
o13-tv-on.note: Usable: one remote, two arms; the TV is clearly on. A lit lamp stands behind, so no request bank on this photo offers the lamp.

o12-lamp-off.observed_description: The same night photo with the floor lamp off: the shade is grey-blue with no warm glow and the room is dark blue; Ana still holds the pole switch.
o12-lamp-off.note: Usable: off reads against o11 at 180 px; a faint blue rim at the bottom of the shade is moonlight, not lamplight.

o14-tv-off.observed_description: The same photo of Luis pointing his remote, with the TV screen now plain black.
o14-tv-off.note: Usable: off reads at 180 px; the lit lamp behind is unchanged, so no request bank on this photo offers the lamp.
